feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Politics chat: Midterm polls, Senate races, Trump in Texas
entry.summary: As polls come out with increasing frequency closer to the midterm election, how much credence should voters give them? Meanwhile, President Trump continues campaigning for GOP candidates.

entry.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
entry.summary: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

entry.title: Week in Politics: Inflation pressure; war in Iran and effect on midterm elections
entry.summary: We look at how some concerning economic indicators as well as the ongoing war in Iran might affect the midterm elections.

entry.title: How high-profile scandals are shaping key contests ahead of the midterms
entry.summary: Scandals could be shaping several races in the midterm elections, particularly in places where even small margins can change the outcome.

entry.title: California voters to decide on controversial one-time tax on billionaires
entry.summary: California voters will decide whether the state will charge a one-time tax on billionaires. The idea that has split Democrats and labor unions.

entry.title: The Supreme Court faces another term jam-packed with controversy
entry.summary: The Supreme Court term opens on Monday with big test cases on religion, guns and climate change. Plus, the emergency docket keeps popping.

entry.title: As Trump's proposed arch looms over D.C., protesters pin their hopes on the midterms
entry.summary: Democratic lawmakers, veterans and concerned citizens gathered in Memorial Circle to protest the arch Trump wants to build there. Their hopes lie primarily in a lawsuit and next month's midterms.

entry.title: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
entry.summary: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

entry.title: San Francisco's car crime has plunged. How much credit does Flock deserve?
entry.summary: San Francisco leaders say AI-powered cameras helped drive a dramatic decline in car crime. We examine the evidence — and whether the city can keep its high-tech dragnet without sacrificing civil liberties.

entry.title: Failed 'torturous' execution attempt on Christa Pike reignites death penalty debate
entry.summary: The botched execution in Tennessee of Christa Pike, who survived despite being subject to two doses of lethal injection on Wednesday, has reignited furious debate about the death penalty in the U.S.
